tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The base every other colour is checked against.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels on ground: the footer, project list, code blocks' frame, the mobile menu's outer frame. In dark it is lighter than ground; in light it is paler than ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders: the nav pill's outline, dividers between project rows, the divider before the nav icons, outlined icon buttons. Decorative only (1.2–1.3:1), so never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All body copy, headings, nav links and the logo's stroke, on ground and surface (14.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground and surface: dates, captions, labels, the footer tagline, "live at" hosts. Dark 6.4:1 or more; light 5.6:1 or more.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brick. The logo's dot, button fills, link underlines, the live signal dot, code keywords, the focus ring. As text, only on ground in dark (4.53:1; 4.16:1 on surface fails, so use link there); light passes on both (5.2:1 / 5.6:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (the button at rest). Dark: near-black on brick, 4.53:1. Light: white on deep brick, 5.9:1. Never white on the dark-theme brick (4.17:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hover colour for text links, nav links and social icons, and standalone links like "all projects". Dark lifts the brick so small text passes on both grounds (5.4:1 ground, 4.96:1 surface); light equals accent.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: The button's hover fill, wiped in by the pointer, and the far end of the ember gradient. Never text on light ground (1.86:1).

tokens.name: on-apricot
tokens.usage: Text on an apricot fill (the hovered button): 8.9:1 dark, 8.5:1 light.

tokens.name: ember-from
tokens.usage: Start of the ember gradient (brick). Linear ember runs ember-from → ember-to; only on large atmospheric areas, never on text, logo, buttons or small UI.

tokens.name: ember-to
tokens.usage: End of the ember gradient (apricot).

tokens.name: cloud-brick
tokens.usage: The upper ember cloud: radial-gradient(60% 80% at 82% 18%, cloud-brick, transparent 70%). Light mode is more saturated to hold its own on the pale ground.

tokens.name: cloud-apricot
tokens.usage: The lower ember cloud: radial-gradient(50% 70% at 98% 92%, cloud-apricot, transparent 70%). Layered under cloud-brick.

tokens.name: signal-ring
tokens.usage: The soft halo around the live dot on deployed projects (a 4px spread ring).

tokens.name: field-dot
tokens.usage: The resting dots of the hero's signal field. Light mode runs darker so the grid stays visible on the pale ground. Near the pointer, dots light up in link.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Syntax: keywords and directives (#if, const, =>). Dark uses the link brick because accent fails on surface (4.96:1 vs 4.16:1); light 5.6:1.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Syntax: text in quotes. Apricot in dark (8.2:1 on surface); a deep amber in light (6.0:1), since apricot is never text on light.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Syntax: numbers, true/false, null. Sand: 10.1:1 dark, 6.3:1 light.

tokens.name: code-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of a highlighted line in a code block, with a 2px accent edge on the left. Opt-in per block ({2-3} after the language).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: The image viewer's backdrop: near-black in dark, white in light, over the page.

tokens.name: overlay-bar
tokens.usage: The image viewer's top and bottom bars, a touch lighter than its backdrop so the image can sit under them.

tokens.name: overlay-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines in the image viewer: the controls' borders, separators and the image's edge.

tokens.name: overlay-panel
tokens.usage: The image viewer's control buttons and zoom bar.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The home page headline only. Fluid: clamp(40px, 6.6vw, 96px) on wide screens, fixed at 44px on phones. Ends in the brick signal dot.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The largest set display size: the name or a statement line in the hero. The hero itself may scale up from here.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Hero statement on a page that is not the home page; large callouts.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Project names in the built-and-shipped list.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Links in the open mobile menu.

styles.name: display-xs
styles.usage: Small display labels; at this size track to -0.04em, not -0.05em.

styles.name: mono-host
styles.usage: Hostnames and short technical strings inline with UI.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks in posts; keywords take accent.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.sample: is sending yourself a test email enough?
styles.usage: The post title (the h1), once per page; balanced wrapping. 32px / 1.15 on phones. Set in Schibsted, not Martian Mono, because titles run past two lines.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: what a test send can’t see
styles.usage: Post sections (##). Listed in "on this page".

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Post sub-sections (###). Listed in "on this page", indented.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Minor headings in a post (####). Not listed. ##### and ###### render as this.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: A test send proves the email can work.
styles.usage: Post text, measure 680px. Paragraphs 1.15em apart.

styles.name: dek
styles.sample: Here’s what a test send catches, and what it quietly misses.
styles.usage: The summary under a post title, in muted (18px on phones). The same text as the post description.

styles.name: title-l
styles.sample: is sending yourself a test email enough?
styles.usage: Section headings ("built and shipped", "keep reading"). Post titles in lists use 21-24px at the same weight.

styles.name: wordmark-l
styles.usage: The name in a large logo lockup (40px mark).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark in the nav; 20px in the footer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If you work in marketing automation, you probably have a version of the same pre-send ritual.
styles.usage: Project descriptions and running text outside posts. Post text uses prose (1.7 line height).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label at the default size; 20px large, 15px in the expanded nav, 14px compact, 16px full-width in the mobile menu.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav links (14px in the compact nav), footer links, inline link rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Dates, captions, meta lines, live-at hosts; set in muted.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Footer legal links and fine print; set in muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Topic chips.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the two social icon buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Live dot to its host text; compact nav's right inset.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Mark to name in the lockup; expanded nav's vertical and right inset; footer column rows.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between mobile menu links; the mobile menu frame's padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Code block padding; phone side gutter; compact nav's left inset.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between links in the compact nav and in project link rows.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Expanded nav's left inset; gap inside the mobile menu; project link row gap.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between nav groups; vertical padding of a project row.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between grid columns (footer, panels).

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Footer and projects panel inner padding; gap between a project's text and its screenshot.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Desktop page side gutter.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, the nav bar, icon buttons, tags and the live dot. The brand's one control shape.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The mobile menu's outer frame; full-bleed section panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and cards: the footer, the projects panel, ember panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Project screenshots; the 64px favicon tile.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks.

tokens.name: shadow-signal
tokens.usage: The halo ring on the live dot. The brand uses no drop shadows: surfaces separate by colour and line.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for icon buttons (GitHub, LinkedIn, close menu).

tokens.name: target-touch
tokens.usage: The GitHub and LinkedIn icons in the mobile menu (plain, no outline).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: The one column: the nav pill's maximum width, and the width every page's content lines up to. Content sits 22px in from the pill's left edge (under the logo) and 10px in from its right edge (under the nav button).

tokens.name: mark-nav
tokens.usage: Logo mark in the expanded nav (24px compact, 28px footer, 30px mobile menu).

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Colour, border, underline and opacity changes on hover and focus, everywhere: links, icon buttons, tags, arrows, chips, the table of contents, the image viewer's controls.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: Fades: the theme icon's opacity, the hero's scroll cue, the consent switch's colours, the preferences dialog's scrim.

tokens.name: duration-switch
tokens.usage: The consent switch's knob sliding across.

tokens.name: duration-zoom
tokens.usage: The image viewer zooming and moving the image.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: The nav compacting, underlines drawing in, the consent categories' chevron turning.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Panels swapping or opening: the projects switcher's panes, the preferences dialog.

tokens.name: duration-arrive
tokens.usage: The cookie banner rising into place.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: The theme toggle's icon turning.

tokens.name: duration-wipe
tokens.usage: The button's apricot wipe.

tokens.name: duration-hint
tokens.usage: The image viewer's hint fading out.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover changes, fades and the nav compacting.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Things moving across: the wipe, underlines, the switch knob, panes, the theme icon.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Things coming to rest: the cookie banner, the preferences dialog, the image viewer's zoom.
